summary: The study investigates the structural and electrical properties of Zr xTiyO2 films grown on RuO2 substrates by ALD. The films were grown at 225°C using water as an oxygen source. The variation in the ALD cycle ratio of ZrO2//ZrO2 + TiO2, R Zr//Zr+Ti, affects the dielectric constant and leakage current density of the films. Postannealing at 600°C resulted in a rutile structure and a dielectric constant of 90 for 15 nm thick films. The addition of Zr content improved leakage current density but decreased the dielectric constant.
evidence: We have investigated the structural and electrical properties of Zr xTiyO2 films grown on a RuO2 substrate by atomic layer deposition with a variation of the ALD cycle ratio of ZrO2//ZrO2 + TiO2, R Zr//Zr+Ti. 225°C using water as an oxygen source showed a rutile structure and a dielectric constant of 90 after postannealing at 600°C. With an increase of R Zr//Zr+Ti to 0.50, the leakage current density of 15 nm thick Zr xTiyO2 films grown at 225°C was improved to be 1.2 × 10−6 A/cm2, but the dielectric constant decreased to 20.
